chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both), he said:
Indeed, Fatima (peace be upon her) made an offering for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) and gave the midwife a leg of lamb and a dinar.

key_terms.رَجُلَ شَاةٍ: A leg of a sheep (a specific cut of meat)
key_terms.عَقَّتْ: She performed the ritual offering (aqiqah) for a newborn

ai.seo_question: What did Fatima (peace be upon her) give the midwife for the birth of Hasan and Husayn?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt by detailing Lady Fatima’s specific practice of the Aqiqah for Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn, emphasizing the generosity and ritual purity associated with their birth. It underscores the scholarly view that the gifts to the midwife were not merely payment but acts of gratitude (shukr) integral to the ritual, reflecting the high status of the Prophet’s daughters in Shia tradition.
